candidates.snippet: -247: Became King of Qin - Ascended to the throne as King Zheng of Qin, initiating his rule over the state of Qin. -221: Unified China - Conquered the last rival states, unifying China and declaring himself Qin Shi Huang, the First Emperor. -246: Began Mausoleum Construction - Initiated the construction of his massive mausoleum, including the Terracotta Army, a monumental undertaking. -210: Death of Qin Shi Huang - The First Emperor died during a tour of Eastern China, leading to a succession crisis.
